---
applyTo: "server.js,lib/**,api/**,platform/**,supabase/**,**/*auth*.js,**/*auth*.ts,**/*security*.js,**/*security*.ts"
---
Security is blocking.
Verify session trust, server-side role/scope, RLS, validation, secrets, private data, safeguarding and auditability.
Never trust client-selected roles, leak credentials, weaken RLS, or mutate production permissions without explicit approval.
